title: Pipeline run (bench-run record for a runnable DAG)
description: ADR-0007 §5.3. Immutable, append-only record of ONE execution of a runnable Pipeline (its `steps` DAG) by the executor (loop/run_pipeline.py). The multi-step counterpart of a `tool_run`: where a tool_run is one Tool on one input, a pipeline_run is the compose/map chain of Tools, each step drift-checked and stamped, threaded by the ref language. Like tool_run it is value-NEUTRAL bench provenance — it carries the Pipeline's id but NOT a hypothesis verdict (the Pipeline node owns the bet; an Experiment that TESTS the pipeline owns the confirmed/refuted status via run_record.tests). It must not pollute the experiment corpus that drives claim blast-radius. The whole run is refused (status='drift_refused') if ANY step's binding is stale, unless forced (recorded honestly per step via hash_ok).

id.description: Pipeline-run id: 'pr_' + the pipeline slug (hyphens -> underscores) + '_' + a run timestamp, lowercase underscore. Stable forever; may be cited by claims/goals as provenance.

pipeline.description: pipeline id that was run. Referential: must resolve to a pipeline node that has a non-empty `steps` DAG.

status.description: ok = every step ran to completion. drift_refused = a step's drift-check failed and the DAG was NOT run past it. error = a step was invoked but raised (see step.error / top-level error).

steps.description: Per-step result, in execution order. The DAG made legible: which Tool, at which version/hash, op, wall, and an output digest.

step.description: The step id from the pipeline's steps[].

tool_version.description: The Tool's current_version at run time.

status.description: skipped = an earlier step refused/errored so this one never ran.

hash_at_run.description: Bound source-file hash at run time (tool_lint format).

hash_ok.description: True iff hash_at_run matched the card's current_hash.

n_mapped.description: op=map only: how many elements `over` was lifted across.

metrics.description: Output digest (return-value shapes/keys/scalars), same summariser as tool_run.

artifacts_produced.description: ADR-0007. artifact_instance ids reified from this step's port-typed outputs ('recognised materials only'). Referential: each must resolve to an artifact_instance. The materials this step put on the shelf.

input.description: The pipeline-level inputs the DAG was run on (resolved by `$in.<key>` refs in step inputs).

params.description: Pipeline-level param overrides, keyed by step id, layered over each step's params/default_params.

wall_s.description: Total wall-clock seconds for the whole DAG.

oracle_clean.description: True iff no step read truth_*/oracle data (false if any step's Tool is an oracle Tool, e.g. load_truth). Mirrors tool_run.oracle_clean.

error.description: Top-level failure reason for status in {drift_refused, error}; null for ok.

reason.description: Operator note: WHY this pipeline was run (bench-log annotation).

commit.description: git SHA the run executed at.
